name: 海康易教学助手
tagline: 海康威视开发的一个类似希沃白板的教学软件
taglineEn: Hikvision's teaching software similar to Seewo Whiteboard
description: 一个类似于希沃白板的软件，但是自带PPT组件和画笔功能，在任何页面都可以调用画笔，全屏PPT后自动适配PPT翻页按键等，自带白板功能，无需登录也能使用大部分功能
descriptionEn: A Seewo Whiteboard-like app that includes built-in PPT controls and pen tools. The pen can be invoked on any page, PPT page-turn keys are adapted automatically in fullscreen, and it includes a whiteboard. Most features work without signing in.
author: 海康威视
